notes: The stylist's own season palettes, read off her wheel chart (twelve 3x10 swatch grids).
The chart is a screenshot: each colour is the median of a small patch of one tile, so it is
close to the printed swatch but not exact. Her chart does not group the colours; they are
sorted here: neutrals (near-grey, or very dark / very light with modest chroma - navy, chocolate,
cream; 6 to 12 per season), then base (the quieter half of the rest) and accents (the stronger half). It has no "avoid" colours, so that group is still the generated one.
